scenes.narration: Mùa nước nổi, dòng sông bao la trôi ngược lên trời, cuốn theo những ngôi nhà và cả con đường đến trường của em bé.
scenes.narration_en: In the rising water season, the vast river flows upward against the sky, carrying houses and the child's path to school away with it.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of a Vietnamese mother in simple grey clothes rowing a small wooden boat on a swollen muddy river during flood season. A young student in a yellow raincoat sits facing forward holding textbooks tightly. Golden sunset light reflects off the water, creating long ripples. Background shows submerged tree roots and floating debris under warm atmospheric haze.

scenes.narration: Mẹ chèo miết đôi tay chai sạn, tiếng mái chạch gào réo giữa dòng nước cuồn cuộn dâng cao mỗi lúc một mạnh.
scenes.narration_en: The mother rows furiously with her calloused hands; the oar screams loudly against water rising violently higher and stronger by the moment.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical close-up of weathered, rough-skinned female arms gripping a wooden paddle hard. Water splashes dynamically around them as they push through dark brown floodwaters. Soft diffused morning light illuminates droplets on skin and wet hair strands hanging down naturally without makeup or jewelry.

scenes.narration: Em bé nép vào mẹ, đôi mắt long lanh sợ hãi nhìn những cây chuối khổng lồ bị nước nhấn chìm như lâu đài cổ.
scenes.narration_en: The child clings to her mother's chest with terrified wide eyes watching giant banana trees being submerged like ancient castles by the floodwaters below them both together now suddenly scared.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical medium shot from behind showing small back of frightened elementary school age girl wearing yellow raincoat hugging adult woman tightly while looking at massive uprooted plants floating nearby. Misty grey-blue morning light filters through low-hanging clouds creating soft shadows on faces and wet fabric textures visible clearly.

scenes.narration: Bỗng một cơn gió mạnh quật ngã cành cây khô, sóng to ập tới nhưng mẹ vẫn giữ vững tay lái không rời bến.
scenes.narration_en: Suddenly a strong wind knocks down dry branches; large waves crash toward them yet the mother keeps steering steadily without letting go of shore or losing control ever again today here now.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical action shot capturing turbulent muddy floodwaters crashing against small wooden boat being rocked violently by sudden storm surge. Mother leans forward intensely gripping oars tightly while child hides face into her shoulder trembling slightly due to fear caused by dangerous conditions surrounding them currently happening right there together immediately visible movement captured dynamically.

scenes.narration: Cuối cùng, bờ trường hiện ra giữa đám tre rậm rạp. Mẹ đưa em cập bến an toàn dưới ánh nắng đầu tiên của ngày mới.
scenes.narration_en: Finally school bank appears among dense bamboo groves; mother docks child safely under first rays of new day sunlight warming their tired bodies gently after long journey through dangerous waters together finally reaching destination successfully today morning hours passing quickly now.
